RAMA

THE SILENT CYLINDER

You are the last surveyor aboard the world-ship — a hollow cylinder fifty kilometres long, falling through the solar system. It is waking up around you. Seven trials stand between you and the southern pole.

Tap glowing markers to look, take & travel — blue chevrons move you.
Tap pack items to read or select them, then tap the scene to use them.
